title: Speeding up agentic workflows with WebSockets in the Responses API
summary: A deep dive into the Codex agent loop, showing how WebSockets and connection-scoped caching reduced API overhead and improved model latency.
body: A deep dive into the Codex agent loop, showing how WebSockets and connection-scoped caching reduced API overhead and improved model latency.
summaryZh: OpenAI通过在Responses API中引入WebSockets技术，显著优化了智能体工作流的响应速度。该方案利用连接作用域缓存减少了API开销，有效降低了模型延迟，提升了智能体执行复杂任务的实时性。
